A '''Snoozling''' is a {{Rare}} [[Mutation]].

== Obtaining ==
A '''Snoozling''' can grow in the [[Greenhouse]] if there are {{Item|Creambloom|amount=4}}, {{Item|Dustgrain|amount=3}}, {{Item|Witherbloom|amount=3}}, {{Item|Duskbloom|amount=3}}, and {{Item|Thornshade|amount=3}} within {{Green|1}} block of a {{Green|3x3}} area of farmland.

While growing, a '''Snoozling''' needs water and has {{Green|20}} {{Dark Green|Growth Stages}}. When placed near another crop, it allows for additional items to be found.

While growing, a '''Snoozling''' falls asleep during {{Dark Green|Growth Stages}} {{Green|5}}, {{Green|10}}, and {{Green|15}}. It cannot grow until right-clicked to be woken up.

== Crop Drops ==
When harvested, '''Snoozlings''' also drop {{Item|Cactus|amount=3150}}, {{Item|Moonflower|amount=4200}}, {{Item|Sunflower|amount=4200}}, {{Item|Sugar Cane|amount=4200}}, and {{Skill XP|33600 Farming}}.

== Usage ==
=== Crop Analyzer ===
A '''Snoozling''' can be analyzed in the [[Crop Analyzer]] for {{c|600k}}. When analyzed, it grants {{Copper|300}}. The first time analyzing a '''Snoozling''' grants an additional {{Copper|750}}.

=== Mutations ===
'''Snoozlings''' are used to create a {{Item|PlantBoy Advance}}, {{Item|Puffercloud}}, {{Item|Stoplight Petal}}.
